title: A Locally Tokenized Generative Model for Robust Time-Series Watermarking
abstract: arXiv:2608.19727v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Watermarking is a central tool for provenance in generative models, yet its application to multivariate time series remains hindered by reliability failures under post-editing attacks. We show that existing detectors, which rely on globally coupled re-encoding, suffer from bidirectional drift of the null distribution: post-editing attacks can shift the z-score of non-watermarked samples in either direction, invalidating clean-calibrated thresholds. We argue that this instability is a property of the re-encoding, and that reliable detection requires each recovered unit to depend only on a bounded temporal neighborhood. Guided by this principle, we propose L-VQVAE, a generative model in which each discrete token is produced from a short contiguous window, and LVQMark, a watermarking method over this token space that combines logit-bias injection with robust re-encoding for attack-time detection. translated_title: 一种用于鲁棒时间序列水印的局部令牌化生成模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19727v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：水印是生成模型中溯源的核心工具，但其在多变量时间序列中的应用仍因后编辑攻击下的可靠性失败而受阻。我们表明，现有依赖全局耦合重编码的检测器存在零分布的双向漂移问题：后编辑攻击可以将非水印样本的z分数向任一方向偏移，从而使干净校准的阈值失效。我们认为这种不稳定性是重编码的属性，而可靠的检测要求每个恢复单元仅依赖于有界的时间邻域。基于这一原则，我们提出了L-VQVAE，一种生成模型，其中每个离散令牌由短连续窗口生成，以及LVQMark，一种在该令牌空间上的水印方法，结合了logit偏差注入与鲁棒重编码以用于攻击时检测。在四个基准上的实验跨越了多种场景，验证了其有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种局部令牌化生成模型L-VQVAE和配套水印方法LVQMark，通过确保每个恢复单元仅依赖有界时间邻域，解决了时间序列水印在后编辑攻击下的检测可靠性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a locally tokenized generative model L-VQVAE and watermarking method LVQMark, which address detection reliability under post-editing attacks by ensuring each recovered unit depends only on a bounded temporal neighborhood.
